sources.entry: High Scalability: great blog about system architecture, its weekly review article are packed with numerous insights and interesting technology reviews. Checkout the all-times favorites.

summary.title: All Time Favorites - High Scalability
summary.one_liner: A long, unannotated index of High Scalability blog posts on system architecture, scaling case studies (YouTube, Pinterest, Twitter, WhatsApp, Netflix and others) and distributed-systems patterns.
keywords: how do big sites handle scale
takeaways: Find curated links to High Scalability posts on how large sites such as YouTube, Twitter, Pinterest and WhatsApp were built and scaled.
See recurring themes: sharding, denormalization, caching, NoSQL vs SQL, cloud architecture and tail latency.
Use the list as a starting index; the page itself gives only titles, with no summaries or dates.
summary.summary: This page is a flat list of article titles that the High Scalability blog considers its favorites, with no descriptions, dates or authors attached. Titles cover company architecture case studies (YouTube, Google, Amazon, Pinterest, Twitter, Instagram, Netflix, Uber and others), general scalability patterns and bottlenecks, database topics such as sharding, NoSQL and Redis, and some papers such as Borg and Spanner. Many titles are repeated several times in the list. Readers need to follow the links to learn what each post actually says.
